description: Create a Locus Skill package with validated package metadata. Ask the user to choose the current Project or the local Locus installation before calling this tool unless the request already states the scope. Project packages are created under `<project>/Locus/skills/<package-id>/`; app packages are created under the Locus package root such as `%APPDATA%/locus/skills/<package-id>/` on Windows. Never create packages in external or system Agent skill directories such as `.codex/skills` or `.claude/skills`. Returns the created Skill path, command trigger, and packageRoot for later filesystem edits.

source.description: Required creation scope selected by the user: `project` for the current Project, or `app` for the local Locus installation.

packageId.description: Optional Locus Skill package id, for example `asset-audit`, `studio.tools.asset-audit`, or `io.github.user.asset-audit`. When omitted, Locus derives a short kebab-case id from `name`.

summary.description: Required one-line load guidance. Locus writes it to both `skill.json.description` and root `SKILL.md` frontmatter `summary`.

body.description: Optional initial `SKILL.md` content. It may include canonical frontmatter such as `tools`; Locus writes or replaces frontmatter `summary` and adds an H1 title when absent. Omit it to create an H1 title and `## Instructions`.

commandTrigger.description: Optional slash command trigger. Defaults to the final package-id segment.

commandEnabled.description: Whether the package exposes a slash command. Defaults to true.

modelInvocationEnabled.description: Whether the package can be selected automatically by the model. Defaults to true.
